description: This file contains utility functions for benchmarking and schema flattening, including temporary directory management, schema flattening, and parsing side-by-side Python and C++ statements.

methods.name: get_temp_dir
methods.description: Creates and returns a temporary directory for instruction count microbenchmarks, registering its cleanup at program exit.

methods.name: _flatten
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested schema into a flat definition, asserting no duplicate keys and correct types.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Public function that initiates schema flattening and validates the result.

methods.name: parse_stmts
methods.description: Parses a string containing side-by-side Python and C++ code snippets, returning separate Python and C++ code blocks.
